title: AVEVA PI System creates smooth sailing for Caterpillar's marine operations
summary: Caterpillar's CAT Asset Intelligence provides "whole-ship monitoring" for remote condition checks, predictive maintenance and compliance support. It is powered by PI System, with PI Servers onboard and onshore.
challenge: Vessels are complex, weather and ocean conditions add "noise" to the data, and data was held in silos onboard each ship.
solution: CAT Asset Intelligence, powered by PI System with PI Servers onboard and onshore linked by PI connectors.

outcomes.text: About $450,000 per vessel per year from timing barnacle removal (hull fouling)
About $10,000 saved in 2018 by catching an abnormal cylinder temperature on a cruise liner
"Hundreds of thousands of dollars" from reduced downtime and fuel burn

title: Chartering a course to net zero
summary: CSL Group sends ship-to-shore data from more than 40 self-unloading vessels to AVEVA PI Data Infrastructure, using Edge Data Store onboard and prioritised satellite transfer.
challenge: A target of a 35% CO2 cut by 2030, limited bandwidth and frequent crew turnover.
solution: Edge Data Store with prioritised satellite transfer, enriched with voyage, weather, traffic, geofencing and compliance context.

outcomes.text: 8,233 mt CO2e avoided across 11 vessels in a year (third-party verified)
Up to 50% upload bandwidth reduction ship-to-shore
14,000 tons of marine gas oil substituted

title: AVEVA PI System helps virtually train maritime crews
summary: Delfi ILS Solutions' ShipView, built on PI System, feeds live ship automation data into 3D crew-training simulations.
challenge: A varied fleet, where manuals alone were not enough to train crews.

outcomes.text: Qualitative: "We reduce the training cost at scale"
